reason: Measured native180, globally projected180 and hybrid180 pilots retain discrete conservation but fail population-distribution consistency. Extra collision quadrature alone does not add the occupation degrees of freedom needed to resolve those populations.
amended_requirement: The accepted dynamic occupations may use a new, explicit complementary fixed-count quadrature. This replaces only the requirement that the dynamic electronic state vector have the original180 occupations. It does not relax any error tolerance, remove an adversarial profile, redefine a failed pilot as passed, or alter the archived R2 catalogue.
required_energy: Ubar = Uvac_R2(delta,Gamma) + 4 sum_j w_j E(x_j;delta,Gamma,eta) p_j. The state coordinates x_j and positive weights w_j are fixed in time. All operators, forces, source normalization, temperature inversion and ledgers use this same potential and these same populations.

required_derivatives.field_forces: Derivative of the same vacuum plus4 sum_j w_j p_j dE/dfield; never a separately fitted force

new_evidence_required: Save the complementary count nodes, weights, eta, physical support, scales and exact parent hash; report the changed state dimension
Independently verify direct causal energies and original spectral-equation residuals at normal, Gamma0, tinyGamma, nearGamma=delta and gapless fields
Verify both field derivatives and the energy derivative identity without mistaking finite-difference cancellation for a physical failure
Reject nonpositive/nonmonotone energies, invalid populations, nonfinite roots and unsupported field/count queries without repair
Repeat population and reaction convergence with at least three genuinely different electronic grids; changing only event quadrature is insufficient
Separate electronic-state resolution, collision quadrature, phonon interpolation, infrared/upper support, eta and time errors
For projected operators compare the electronic weak response against the same physical basis; retain the collocation diagnostic separately
Benchmark before full lightweight trajectories; keep the five-minute computation policy and record any long required command for the user
verdict_policy: An admitted complementary grid would certify a new numerical representation for the declared synthetic cell scope. It would not retrospectively admit the failed180-state population models, certify absolute NbN, or validate the spatial/full-detector system. Missing evidence remains pending.
